The Nodes page (nodes, under the Control sidebar group) monitors execution nodes and live server/worker instances connected to your PraisonAIUI deployment. On startup, NodesFeature automatically registers the local host node and server instance so the Nodes page immediately reflects the current machine's OS, Python version, and online status.

Method Path Description GET /api/nodes List registered execution nodes and total count POST /api/nodes Register a new execution node (201, returns generated auth token) GET /api/nodes/{node_id} Fetch node details PUT /api/nodes/{node_id} Update name, host, agents, or approval_policy DELETE /api/nodes/{node_id} Remove a node GET /api/nodes/{node_id}/status Check node health, status, and last heartbeat GET / PUT /api/nodes/{node_id}/agents Inspect or assign agents bound to a node GET /api/nodes/instances List connected instances (alias: GET /api/instances) POST /api/instances/heartbeat Record an instance presence heartbeat
Implement NodeProtocol from praisonaiui.features.nodes (list_nodes, register_node, get_node, delete_node, heartbeat) to back node presence with your own orchestrator or service registry.
